description:
Search siilostomy.org in the shopper's language.

    Use this for Italy, Poland, Czechia, Slovakia, Sweden, Denmark, Norway,
    Finland, the Netherlands, Greece, Hungary, Romania, Portugal and Japan.
    English, Spanish, French and German are search_products on siilostomy.com.

    Args:
        query: Words in that language, or a product family (belt, panties).
        lang: it, pl, cs, sk, sv, da, nb, fi, nl, el, hu, ro, pt, ja.
            Country names work too (poland, japan, czech).
        limit: How many products to return. Max 12.

    Returns the title, the photo, the EUR catalog amount, and the product
    page. The page shows the local currency. The person pays on that page.
name: search_org_products
